descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Contract
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Jocuri de computer
Fully Remote – Potentially Hybrid in the future (Bucharest, Romania) 
 Our client is a fast-growing, product-driven technology company building an engaging consumer platform for an international market.
 As the product continues to scale, they are expanding their engineering team and looking for an experienced Front End Developer to take ownership of user-facing experiences across both web and mobile.
 What you'll do: 
Build and ship features across web (React) and mobile (React Native) 
Turn product requirements and designs into responsive, accessible, polished interfaces
Build and extend reusable components and contribute to the design system
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs and WebSockets 
Write clean, maintainable code with unit and component tests 
Improve frontend performance, load times, rendering, and overall UX
Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering
Use AI development tools to improve development, testing, and code review workflows
 What we're looking for: 
 5+ years of professional frontend development experience 
Strong hands-on experience with React and React Native 
Strong JavaScript / TypeScript, HTML and CSS 
Experience with state management tools such as Redux, Zustand, React Query , or similar
Experience working with REST APIs and real-time functionality
Experience with Jest, React Testing Library , or similar testing tools
Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and CI/CD 
Strong attention to UX, performance, and visual detail
Good communication skills and a proactive, ownership-driven mindset
 Nice to have: 
Experience with high-traffic consumer, gaming, entertainment, or highly interactive products 
Experience with animations and gestures
Experience maintaining a component library or design system
